officialSources.observation: Wujiang District government names the Shengze Natural Resources Office, gives its location, and states it manages local land rights, supports land/cadastral and change surveys, registration/certificates, and archive queries.
Official district convenience-services page lists the Shengze town real-estate registration service counter and address.
Suzhou City Management Bureau report describes Shengze internal operational systems using parcel maps (宗地图) as part of land/resource management workflows; this is not a public geometry service.
Official Wujiang land-space planning portal publishes Shengze town planning notices; planning polygons are not cadastral parcel geometry.
